Log audit found **60 total `order_version_mismatch` failures** since Apr 29, concentrated only in active/research hours: 11 UTC 14, 12 UTC 18, 19 UTC 6, 20 UTC 22. **Decision:** No live PM loosening. Keep 11/12 as the only proven core and 19/20 watch/confirmation-only. Do not use 19/20 signals as performance evidence until `order_version_mismatch` is eliminated or one tiny live fill proves the path.
